name: Improved Tanuki Magic
body:
You gain greater spell-like abilities.

Prerequisites: tanuki, tanuki magic species trait.

Benefit: You may use your detect poison and purify food and drink spell-like abilities at will, and you add create food and water, disguise self, and shrink item to the spell-like abilities that you may use once each per day.

Awesome Ancestries: Fantasy Animal Humanoids, Vol. 3 - Born to Be Wild. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
